purpose: Machine-readable plumbing design/checking rules derived from code structure and publicly accessible code information.

rules.condition: Potable water piping is connected to a nonpotable system without an approved backflow/cross-connection protection method.
rules.action: Flag cross-connection and require protection appropriate to the hazard.
rules.source_note: Potable water protection/backflow is governed by Chapter 6.

rules.condition: Static pressure in building water distribution is above the code pressure threshold.
rules.action: Require an approved pressure-reducing/regulating arrangement and verify downstream pressure.
rules.source_note: Publicly accessible IPC-derived text identifies 80 psi static as the threshold.

rules.condition: Quick-closing valves are present but water-hammer control is not provided where required.
rules.action: Check for compliant water-hammer arrestor installation.
rules.source_note: Water-hammer control is addressed in the water-distribution chapter.
